selection_reasoning: These three tasks form a coherent multi-hop sequence centered around exploration and interaction in a Minecraft village/farm setting. The player must first locate a cow (which establishes orientation in the scene), then find an anvil (which is placed near the cow's area, requiring the player to have already navigated to that region), and finally hunt a sheep (which requires the player to have found the anvil area where a weapon/tool is available nearby to accomplish the hunt). This creates a logical dependency: finding the cow orients the player toward the farm area, the anvil is located past the cow pen providing access to equipment context, and the sheep is in a nearby field requiring the player to have traversed through the previous areas. All tasks are observable and verifiable without deep Minecraft crafting knowledge.

edges.reason: The anvil is placed beyond the cow pen; finding the cow orients the player toward the correct area to locate the anvil
The anvil area contains a sword in a nearby chest; the player needs this weapon to successfully hunt the sheep

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate near the cow pen (center ~5, 0, 5) and face toward it. The cows are summoned at (5,1,5) and (4,1,6) inside the fenced pen. max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable range, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the cow area.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The anvil is placed at (-2, 0, 2) near the workstation area. The player must approach within 16 blocks and face toward the anvil. This correctly models 'player can see the anvil' without requiring them to stand on top of it.

Uses count_in_box_at_most(kind='mob', max_count=2) because this is a kill/combat task. Exactly 3 sheep are spawned in the scene. Successfully hunting (killing) at least one sheep means at most 2 remain alive in the detection area. The box is very generous (±15 on X/Z, -2 to +10 on Y) to ensure sheep are always detected regardless of wandering, preventing false positives from a sheep simply walking out of a small box.

scene_description: A compact farm scene with three distinct areas around the player spawn: (1) A cow pen to the front-right (~3-7, ~3-7) with 2 cows inside an oak fence enclosure on dirt, (2) An anvil workstation to the left (~-2, ~2) with a crafting table, chest containing an iron sword, and cobblestone path, and (3) A sheep field to the back-left (~-8 to -5, ~-6 to -2) with 3 sheep inside an oak fence enclosure. The player spawns on oak planks at origin with torches for visibility.
task_text: First, find a cow in the nearby pen. Then locate the anvil at the workstation area. Finally, take the iron sword from the chest and hunt a sheep in the fenced field.
design_notes: Layout: Player spawns at origin on oak planks. Cow pen is at +X/+Z quadrant (3-7 range) with 2 cows on dirt, fully fenced with oak fence and one gate opening at ~5,~3. Anvil workstation at ~-2,~2 with crafting table at ~-2,~1 and chest (iron sword) at ~-2,~3 — all within 3 blocks of spawn. Sheep field at -X/-Z quadrant (-8 to -5, -6 to -2) with 3 sheep, fenced with one opening at ~-6,~-2. Cobblestone path connects spawn to anvil area. Torch at origin for lighting. All areas within 10 blocks of spawn for compact navigation.
